title: Grid Profile Mismatch
shortDescription: Microinverters are not on the profile expected by the utility.
fullDescription:
Enphase microinverters operate on a utility-specific grid profile that controls voltage and frequency thresholds. After a utility change, system expansion, or Envoy update, microinverters can drift off profile.

Re-push the correct profile via Enlighten. Only certified installers can change profile without risking a code violation.

fixSteps.title: Verify required profile
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm the utility profile required for your jurisdiction.

fixSteps.title: Push profile
fixSteps.instruction: Via Enlighten Manager or Installer Toolkit, apply and commit profile.

whenToCallPro: Always. Grid profile changes require a licensed installer.
videoSearchQuery: Enphase grid profile mismatch fix installer

faq.a: No, it typically requires installer-tier access.

title: No DC Input From Module
shortDescription: Microinverter reports module is not producing power.
fullDescription:
A DC power fault means the microinverter senses no PV input. Possible causes include a disconnected MC4, a failed module, shading, or soiling.

DC panel voltage can exceed 40 V per module; treat all wiring as live during daylight.

fixSteps.title: Clean panel
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse dust/snow with low-pressure water when safe.

fixSteps.title: Installer checks MC4
fixSteps.instruction: Installer isolates DC, inspects MC4 continuity.

whenToCallPro: Anything involving DC wiring. PV strings remain live whenever sun is up.

faq.a: Yes, each panel is 30-40 V and cannot be fully shut off during daylight.

title: Grid Voltage Outside Operating Window
shortDescription: Microinverter tripped because utility voltage exceeded limits.
fullDescription:
Microinverters measure grid voltage and trip to comply with IEEE 1547. If the utility voltage is consistently high or low at the service entrance, the array shuts down during the window.

Have the utility measure voltage at the meter and adjust if needed.

causes.cause: Long undersized AC run causing voltage rise

fixSteps.title: Log voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Installer logs AC voltage across a day.

fixSteps.title: Utility adjustment
fixSteps.instruction: Report high service voltage to utility for tap adjustment.

whenToCallPro: Always - grid voltage diagnosis requires installer and utility.
videoSearchQuery: Enphase AC voltage out of range fix

faq.a: Max production causes voltage rise on your service, pushing over the limit.

title: Ground Fault Detected
shortDescription: DC circuit leaking to ground detected.
fullDescription:
A ground fault indicates insulation damage between a DC conductor and ground. NEC requires the array to shut down. Common sources are damaged MC4 pins, pinched wiring under mounts, or water ingress into junction boxes.

This is a shock and fire hazard - do not attempt DIY.

fixSteps.title: Call installer
fixSteps.instruction: Do not reset repeatedly - isolate and call professional.

whenToCallPro: Always. DC ground fault = shock and roof-fire risk.

faq.q: Can I reset a GF alarm?
faq.a: Only after the underlying fault is corrected by an installer.

title: Grid Frequency Outside Window
fullDescription:
Microinverters trip if grid frequency excursions exceed the profile. Brief utility events are normal; persistent trips indicate generator-backed microgrid or unstable utility.

Review the grid profile with the installer if this happens frequently.

fixSteps.title: Monitor
fixSteps.instruction: Check Enlighten for frequency over time.

fixSteps.title: Installer reviews
fixSteps.instruction: If frequent, installer reviews grid profile settings.

whenToCallPro: If trips are frequent or after a utility upgrade.
videoSearchQuery: Enphase frequency out of range fix

faq.a: Usually a utility or generator issue.

title: Microinverter Over Temperature
shortDescription: Internal temperature exceeded safe operating range.
fullDescription:
Microinverters derate output above ~65 C. Sustained over-temp indicates inadequate airflow behind the module, very hot roof surface, or failing thermal pad inside the unit.

Rarely an installation issue; sometimes a sign of a failing microinverter.

fixSteps.title: Warranty claim
fixSteps.instruction: If unit runs hot vs peers, file an RMA.

whenToCallPro: Always - rooftop work and DC handling.

faq.a: Derating protects it, but chronic over-temp shortens life.

title: Envoy Cannot Reach Enphase Cloud
shortDescription: Envoy gateway has no internet or cellular backhaul.
fullDescription:
Envoy gateways backhaul via Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or cellular. Loss of internet stops Enlighten reporting although microinverters continue to produce.

Check LEDs on the Envoy to verify status.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Use Installer Toolkit or local Envoy UI to reconfigure Wi-Fi.

whenToCallPro: If cellular backup fails, call installer.

title: Expected Production Not Met
shortDescription: Array producing significantly less than modeled.
fullDescription:
Enlighten flags when actual production falls well below expected. Causes range from soiling to failed microinverters or panels.

Review per-panel stats in the array view.

fixSteps.title: Clean panels
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse soiling safely from the ground.

whenToCallPro: After cleaning, if output still low.

faq.a: More than 10 percent under expected for the conditions.

title: Envoy Reporting Error
shortDescription: Envoy could not upload a data packet to Enlighten.
fullDescription:
Typically transient, caused by cloud service hiccups or local network flakiness. Repeated errors for hours suggest an Envoy issue.

Reboot Envoy via the app or power cycle.

fixSteps.title: Reboot Envoy
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 30 s or reboot via local UI.

faq.a: No, gaps fill once connectivity restores.

title: Entire Array Not Producing
fullDescription:
Entire-array outage usually means the AC feed to the array is open: PV breaker tripped, AC disconnect opened, or a main panel issue.

Check the solar AC breaker first.

fixSteps.title: Reset breaker
fixSteps.instruction: Flip PV breaker fully OFF then back ON.

fixSteps.title: Check disconnect
fixSteps.instruction: Verify outdoor solar AC disconnect handle is ON.

faq.q: Why does my PV breaker trip?
faq.a: Often nuisance trips from voltage excursion, but could indicate a fault - call installer if repeated.

title: Battery State of Charge Abnormal
fullDescription:
Occasionally an Encharge/IQ Battery loses SOC calibration after deep discharges. Enphase recommends a full charge cycle to recalibrate.

If SOC sticks at 0 or 100, contact installer.

fixSteps.title: Full charge cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Allow battery to hit 100% on grid charge, then use normally.

fixSteps.title: Installer check
fixSteps.instruction: If no improvement, installer reads BMS logs.

whenToCallPro: If calibration does not resolve in 48 hours.

faq.a: Minor drift yes; large jumps warrant service.

title: Single Microinverter Silent
shortDescription: One microinverter missing from Envoy communication.
fullDescription:
An individual microinverter may drop off due to powerline-communication (PLC) noise, AC connector fault, or unit failure.

Enphase covers microinverters under a long warranty; installer replacement is straightforward.
symptoms: Array map has one gray panel

fixSteps.title: Replace unit
fixSteps.instruction: If hardware fault, installer swaps under warranty.

title: Zigbee Radio Failure
fullDescription:
Older Envoy-S systems use Zigbee between the Envoy and consumption CT module. Radio interference or distance can drop the link.

Reseat the Zigbee USB stick and reposition the Envoy away from routers/microwaves.

fixSteps.title: Relocate Envoy
fixSteps.instruction: Move away from Wi-Fi AP and microwaves.

whenToCallPro: Always - Envoy is mounted in load center area.

faq.q: Can I replace the Zigbee dongle?
faq.a: Not end-user serviceable; installer swap only.

title: Envoy Wi-Fi Dropped
shortDescription: Envoy lost Wi-Fi to home router.
fullDescription:
Common after router replacement or SSID change. The Envoy buffers data locally but Enlighten shows a reporting gap.

Use Installer Toolkit or the local Envoy page to rejoin the new network.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Toolkit app > Wi-Fi setup on Envoy.

title: Firmware Update Stalled
shortDescription: Envoy or microinverter firmware update not completing.
fullDescription:
Firmware updates require a stable internet connection and can take an hour. Weak Wi-Fi or early reboot can stall the update.

Leave the system alone for up to 24 hours.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: Allow up to 24 hours for retry.

whenToCallPro: If still stuck after a week.

faq.q: Do I need to click anything?
